title: Scalar compatibility of the actual additive Cech coefficient augmentation
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U any family of opens, I an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the additive etale structure sheaf, and mu a family of coefficient endomorphisms acting on every etale section by multiplication by the pulled-back structural section r. Apply global sections to desc(mu(r),I,I) to obtain G; apply the open Cech functor, flip, and totalize the same descent to obtain F. With alpha and beta of [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization], in every degree n one has F_n(beta_n(y))=beta_n(r*y) for every unit Cech cochain y. The auxiliary theorem additiveCech_alpha_natural separately proves F_n(alpha_n(x))=alpha_n(G_n(x)) for any coefficient endomorphism and global cochain x. This asserts chain-level identities only, without choosing cycle representatives or comparing sheaf cohomology classes.

proof.text: Construct the global and total maps by applying the indicated functors to InjectiveResolution.desc. For alpha, use ιTotal_map to reduce to the Cech-degree-zero product. Test equality against each product projection; Pi.map_π and Pi.lift_π reduce it to naturality of the resolution morphism under restriction from X to the tuple intersection. This proves additiveCech_alpha_natural for every coefficient endomorphism, including empty indexing families.

The total map on a summand is the Čech map of the resolution comparison
in that resolution degree. Use desc_commutes_zero to move the comparison
past I.ι in each tuple coordinate. Substitute hμ, and use naturality of
restrictFunctorΓ to identify the restricted structural section with the scalar
on the module coordinate. The base ring map is the identity by ΓSpecIso and
toSpecΓ, so this coordinate is r times the original coordinate. The product
maps are equal coordinatewise; applying ιTotal_map proves the beta identity.
These arguments include zero scalar, unit scalar, degree zero, and empty products.

lean.statement:
theorem additiveCech_scalar_chain_action
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (μ : Γ(X, ⊤) → (X.etaleAdditiveSheaf ⟶ X.etaleAdditiveSheaf))
    (hμ : ∀ r (W : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : X.etaleAdditiveSheaf.obj.obj W),
      (μ r).hom.app W x =
        ULift.up ((show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from x.down) *
          (show Γ(W.unop.left, ⊤) from W.unop.hom.appTop r)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (n : ℕ) (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    ∀ x : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).X n,
      (additiveCechTotalMap U I (μ r)).f n (additiveCechBeta U I n x) =
        additiveCechBeta U I n (r • x)
